original_extraction.evidence_text:
You may need to focus on this sensation for anywhere from a few seconds to a few minutes, until
you completely give up the struggle with it. Be patient; take as long as you need. You’re learning a
valuable skill. Once you’ve done this, scan your body again and see if there’s another sensation
that’s bothering you. If so, repeat the procedure with this one, too. You can do this with as many
different sensations as necessary. Keep going until you have a sense of no longer struggling with
your feelings. As you practise this technique one of two things will happen: either your feelings will
change or they won’t. It doesn’t matter either way, because this technique is not about changing
your feelings—it’s about accepting them.

---

To give you a better idea of how expansion works, I’ve included a transcript of a session I did with
Donna. This transcript is from our fourth session, by which time Donna was already well-practised
at defusion skills. As this session begins, Donna is sitting opposite me with tears welling up in her
eyes.

---

Russ: You look very upset. What are you feeling right now?

---

Russ: So you’re having the thought that you can’t take it anymore?

---

Russ: Well, thank your mind for that one. (Donna smiles through her tears.) Anything else your
mind is telling you right now?

---

Russ: Your mind doesn’t have much confidence in you, does it?

---

Russ: Okay. Well, thank it again for its valuable contributions. (Donna smiles again.) Now,
remember that struggle switch I was talking about? How when it’s ON it amplifies your emotions
and makes them into a big, dirty mess?

---

Russ: Well, what we’re going to do now is turn that switch OFF. I’m going to ask you to sit with
your emotions and experience them fully, without struggling.
generation_rules: Focus attention on a sensation until the struggle with it is given up
Repeat the process with other sensations as needed
Accept feelings regardless of whether they change
pause_rules: Allow as much time as needed (seconds to minutes) to focus on sensations and give up struggle
original_extraction.psychological_function: Reduces emotional amplification caused by internal struggle; promotes defusion from distressing thoughts and feelings; enhances emotional regulation through acceptance.
repetition_rules: Repeat the acceptance procedure with multiple sensations until no struggle remains
symbolic_elements: struggle switch (ON/OFF) representing amplification or reduction of emotional struggle
original_extraction.therapeutic_function: Facilitates acceptance of difficult emotions by encouraging patients to fully experience sensations without struggling or attempting to change them.
voice_rules: Acknowledge and thank the mind for its contributions
Use metaphorical language (e.g., struggle switch) to illustrate concepts
